title: Make the login/onboarding flow less strict and non-blocking

requirements.text: Update the post-login onboarding so that a missing user profile does not block access to the app. Specifically, when the authenticated user has no saved profile, do not force a modal that prevents interacting with the app; instead allow the user to continue and optionally complete profile setup.

quotes: Thanks for efforts but it's not use don't make login page that strict it's not usable for me

acceptanceCriteria: After logging in with Internet Identity, the user can reach the Invoices page even if no user profile exists yet.
The app does not show an always-open modal that prevents clicking elsewhere when the profile is missing.
If profile setup UI is shown, it includes a clear non-destructive option to defer/skip and continue using the app.

requirements.text: Relax backend authorization for basic user bootstrap so newly authenticated principals can read/create their own profile and fetch their effective role without being pre-granted permissions. Ensure these methods only reject anonymous callers, not first-time authenticated users.

quotes: don't make login page that strict it's not usable for me

acceptanceCriteria: A newly authenticated principal can successfully call getCallerUserProfile (returns null/none) without trapping due to authorization.
A newly authenticated principal can successfully call saveCallerUserProfile without trapping due to authorization.
A newly authenticated principal can successfully call getCallerUserRole (or equivalent existing role API used by the frontend) and receive a sensible default role (e.g., "user") without trapping.

requirements.text: Adjust authenticated routing and layout rendering to handle users with missing/unknown role gracefully (treat as a non-admin default) so the UI remains usable while profile/role data loads or is absent.
acceptanceCriteria: When authenticated and role is missing/undefined, the app defaults to the non-admin navigation and does not crash or get stuck on a loading state.
Admin-only navigation items remain hidden unless the resolved role is explicitly "admin".
User-facing text for any new prompts/buttons/toasts is in English.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; create backend/migration.mo only if an upgrade-state migration is required.

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Removing Internet Identity authentication or adding third-party authentication providers.
Changing existing business workflows for invoices, payments, reports, or data reset beyond what is needed to make login/onboarding less strict.
Granting admin privileges to everyone by default.
